notes.title: Occlusion maps, height maps and more!
notes.content:
A new version of AutoTileGen is up! Here are some of the most noticeable changes:

New features:
- Added automatic height maps generation
- Added automatic oclussion maps generation
- UI improvements
- New AutoTileSet version
- Improved performance

Fixed bugs:
- Alpha blending now working properly
- Fixed "pink screen" bug on Mac
- Fixed normal map editor height curve offset
- Lots of other minor bugfixes

We put a lot of work on this patch and really hope you like it. 
We are currently working on our next product, a Collectible Card Game editor/creator. If you want to support us, help us get greenlit at:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=495108255

Have a nice day!

tags.bug: - Fixed normal map editor height curve offset

notes.title: AutoTileGen 2.0 is out!
notes.content:
- Added "share tileset to steam workshop" feature
- Improved tileset rendering times
- Advanced normal map generation with many custom parameters
- New "push-to-bend-corners" mask mode
- Reorderable output layout
- Completely redesigned & remade UI
- Added outline generation option
- Added per-corner settings AKA: Advanced Mode
- Zoomable preview interface
- Completely remade sprite editor
- Full sprite edit tools set: pencil, eraser, colorpicker, line, rectangle, circle, bucket, select, rotate, replace, mirror and more)
- Added a new mask editor
- Added a "mask builder" to easily generate template masks
- Many bugfixes
- Completely remade undo system (huge performance boost)
- New palette manager with sample palettes included
- Added in-app documentation via tooltips

notes.title: 1.5.2 Update Patch
notes.content:
AutoTileGen Changelog 1.5.2

[b]Features/improvements:[/b]
- Added background tile slot
- Added RPGMaker format export (AKA: "compact export")
- Added RPGMaker  export tutorial (http://autotilegen.com/rpgmaker/)
- Updated vertical layout
- Changed renderer to DX11
- Updated preview window to display the new background tiles

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
- Fixed file browser issues on Mac/Linux
- Removed tool selections from undo queue


[h1]AutoTileGen Changelog 1.5.1[/h1]

[b]Features/improvements:[/b]

- Added a new vertical "advanced"/"compact" layout (upper right exclamation mark)
- Upgraded to Unity Pro / no unity splash screen
- Added undo feature to the canvas editor
- Added hotkeys (hover over items to see them)
- Output folder is now saved between runs
- Improved output GUI layout
- Added 8x8 example tilesets
- Added example tiles+tileset explaining the output layout
- Added fullscreen support with alt+enter
- Removed in-app close button

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]

- Fixed window resizing issues
- Fixed multi-monitor issues
- Fixed saving on parent folder
- Fixed project name display
- Fixed folder string processing
- Removed fullscreen on startup bug
- Improved performance
- Fixed point-filtering mode unset on tile change
- Fixed undo not registering after tool change
